botMessages.message: Hi, I'm Ask Nimbus. I can help with billing, accounts, workspaces, integrations, data and compliance, troubleshooting, or security questions about Nimbus Workspace. What can I help you with?
Sorry, something went wrong on my end. Please try again, or ask to speak with a specialist.

conversationVariables.description: Developer name of the domain subagent most recently entered. Used by each domain subagent's before_reasoning to detect a topic change and reset the per-topic counters above.
conversationVariables.label: Active Domain

conversationVariables.description: Count of low-confidence or user-flagged-unhelpful responses since the last topic change. At 3, forces escalation with unresolved_after_3_turns.
conversationVariables.label: Unresolved Turns

conversationVariables.description: Number of escalate_to_human calls made for the current escalation. Caps repeated retries at 3 so a persistently failing Apex call cannot loop indefinitely within one turn.
conversationVariables.label: Escalation Attempts

conversationVariables.description: Runtime condition evaluation for if statements
conversationVariables.label: Runtime Condition 1

conversationVariables.description: Which deterministic escalation trigger fired, if any. Empty when no trigger is active. Consumed by every subagent's top-of-instructions redirect and by escalateToHuman's reasonCode input.
conversationVariables.label: Escalation Reason Code

conversationVariables.description: Consecutive clarifying questions asked for the current topic. Reset on topic change. Capped at 2 by subagent instructions.
conversationVariables.label: Clarifying Questions Asked

conversationVariables.description: The next topic to be visited
conversationVariables.label: Next Topic

conversationVariables.description: Whether escalate_to_human has been called at least once for the current escalation. Consumed by the escalation subagent's retry-branch condition.
conversationVariables.label: Escalation Attempted

conversationVariables.description: Runtime condition evaluation for else-if chain link 3
conversationVariables.label: Runtime Condition 3

conversationVariables.description: Consecutive empty AnswerQuestionsWithKnowledge results for the current topic. Reset on topic change. At 2, forces escalation with no_confident_answer.
conversationVariables.label: Retrieval Attempts

conversationVariables.description: Runtime condition evaluation for else-if chain link 2
conversationVariables.label: Runtime Condition 2

conversationVariables.description: Number of user turns handled by a domain subagent this session. At 12, subagent instructions proactively offer a human hand-off.
conversationVariables.label: Turn Count

conversationVariables.description: Domain queue hint (Billing/Technical/General/LegalTrust) recorded by whichever subagent triggered escalation. Consumed by escalateToHuman's queueHint input.
conversationVariables.label: Pending Queue Hint

conversationVariables.description: Trusted output of escalateToHuman.isSuccess. Gates escalate_to_human (hides it once True) and hand_off_to_human (shows it once True).
conversationVariables.label: Escalation Case Created
